verdict: too few settled forecasts to judge
note: Of 4 forecasts whose horizon has passed, 0.0% closed inside the 10-90 band. A calibrated band gives about 80%.

cautions.not_a_probability: Band width is not a probability. Nothing here estimates the chance of a level being reached.
cautions.young: The record is days old. A coverage figure from a handful of settled forecasts is noise, and the verdict says so below 100 cases.
cautions.breakers_are_facts: A range breaker is a stock that moved further than the model expected. It is a fact about the past, not a signal.
